en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny who said,
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said to the men: ‘Clip your nails’, and (said) to the women: ‘Leave them for it is an adornment for you’.
en.sarwar: 15. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
Men must clip their fingernails and women must keep them because it is more beautifying for them.’”
